messages.subject: geomorph summer school at University of Copenhagen
parts:
Dear GMers,

I'm happy to announce that registration for our free PhD summer school on Geometric Morphometrics in R is now open at University of Copenhagen. The course will run from 5-10 august 2024, and cover working knowledge of the theory of geometric morphometrics, as well as practical training in applying those methods in R.

The course will be mainly taught by the geomorph godfathers Dean & Mike, with an extra day on image acquisition and landmarking by myself and GBIF staff. 

Please note that the course is open to all students, danish and otherwise, but that space is limited to 30 people (with a waiting list).

See https://phdcourses.ku.dk/ for more details.

Best,
Christy Hipsley
Associate Professor, University of Copenhagen
www.evomorpholab.com
